# Code Anchors: Workspace Resolution

- `libs/workspace/src/resolve.ts` — the single resolver entry point: role dispatch by which artifact is present, an upward marker walk bounded to the repository's own top-level git boundary, single-repo fallback reporting that enclosing boundary rather than the caller's starting directory, per-member checkout-state annotation, and each repo's docs root as resolved context (the tooling-location field and its path constant were removed), plus the thin docs-root-only selector both read-outs call.
- `libs/workspace/src/manifest.ts` — reads/parses/validates the hub manifest into the canonical workspace description; emits the structural diagnostics, rejects a member reusing the hub's name or remote, validates the optional hub docs-root override, and validates the optional workspace-wide publishing-defaults block against its allowed key set, carrying it verbatim.
- `libs/workspace/src/manifest.spec.ts` — covers the publishing-defaults block: allowed keys, rejection of an unknown key or a non-string value, and absence when undeclared.
- `libs/workspace/src/pointer.ts` — reads a member's hub pointer, locates the hub as a named sibling, and emits the member-side diagnostics (missing pointer, missing hub checkout, hub-remote mismatch, undeclared member).
- `libs/workspace/src/status.ts` — renders the status read-out (resolved workspace, single-repo mode, or failure) as plain terminal text, including each repo's docs root.
- `libs/workspace/package.json` — the shared `@nexus/workspace` package: subpath exports, no barrel.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the read-out verbs built on this resolver: the full workspace status, the in-repo docs root that surfaces a named diagnostic rather than a silent fallback, and the repositories a story-verdict search spans (#521)
- `components/skills/nxs-workspace-status/SKILL.md` — the workspace status read-out skill; now also documents the companion docs-root read-out and its two vehicles.
- `.nexus/config/templates/workspace-template.yml` — the hub manifest template leads copy into a real hub; documents the optional docs-root override and the optional workspace-wide publishing-defaults block with its per-key inheritance.
- `.nexus/config/templates/hub-template.yml` — the member pointer template.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — resolves the feature container path once under the docs root, and records it in the queue entry; stub promotion reads issue state only and globs nothing under the resolved root.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — reads the recorded feature path and writes the process lesson under it, never re-resolving the root; deferred scope is filed as stub issues rather than written to the tree (#521)
- `components/commands/nxs.setup.md` — scaffolds the product, system, and delivery docs under the resolved docs root.
- `components/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — hands the resolved context-doc locations into the design brief in place of fixed paths.
- `components/commands/nxs.council.md` — resolves the docs root once and threads it into the product-manager and architect briefs.
- `components/agents/nxs-pm.md` — reads the product context from the resolved location the invoking command hands in; its prior-decisions check, project-templates check, and decision-record path also read the resolved docs root.
- `components/agents/nxs-architect.md` — reads the system standards from the resolved location during its conformance pass.
- `components/skills/nxs-setup/SKILL.md` — the product-context interview writes its output under the resolved docs root.
- `libs/abs-doc-path/src/resolve.ts` — the doc-link builder that reads the resolver's docs root, strips exactly that prefix when converting a repo-relative path to an absolute URL, and errors when its configured URL disagrees with the resolved root.
- `components/skills/nxs-abs-doc-path/SKILL.md` — the cross-ref doc-link skill (docs-root strip and URL-agreement check).
- `libs/workspace/src/resolve.spec.ts` — parity, single-repo fallback, checkout-state, docs-root resolution (incl. the docs-root-only selector), and the bounded upward walk (nested marker discovery, the never-cross-the-repo-boundary case, and the landed-directory single-repo report); its tooling-location assertions were removed with the field.
- `libs/workspace/src/pointer.spec.ts` — member-side resolution and diagnostics.
- `libs/workspace/src/status.spec.ts` — read-out rendering across the three cases, including the docs root.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/cross-ref-docs-root.spec.ts` — subprocess coverage of the doc-link builder's docs-root strip and URL-agreement behavior in both layouts.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/workbook-placement.ts` — a consumer that asks this resolver which member checkout a workbook belongs in and refuses the hub, re-deriving no workspace shape.
